captions.detailed: A classic OCC-style bottle with a semi-transparent, pale green container body and a solid black plastic cap. The bottle body is tall and flattened with rounded edges, tapering slightly toward the bottom. The cap assembly is mounted on top of the narrow neck and features a small hinge mechanism on its side, allowing the cap to pivot open and closed.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated classic OCC bottle with a semi-transparent green body and a black plastic cap. The cap should be connected to the bottle neck via a revolute joint to simulate an opening and closing hinge.
captions.factory: The bottle body is constructed as a base part using a flattened, extruded profile with rounded corners and a narrow cylindrical neck. A second part for the cap is created from a solid black cylinder with a small rectangular hinge protrusion. These two parts are assembled using a revolute joint positioned at the hinge location to allow realistic rotational opening.
